idea-plugin.name: Panda Modern Dark
idea-plugin.description:
Panda Modern Dark for IntelliJ IDEA and Android Studio.

Near-black surfaces, blue types, purple functions, cyan properties, orange keywords, green strings, and neutral ordinary parameters.

Includes Java, Kotlin, Dart, and XML editor colors. Dart highlighting requires the Dart plugin. Dart named argument labels remain neutral because the Dart plugin shares their color key with ordinary parameter references.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First JetBrains release, based on the approved Panda Modern Dark VS Code 1.1.1 palette.
